name: Annual Return Filing
penalty: ₹100 per day of delay as per Rule 11 of Companies (Management & Administration) Rules, 2014
notes: File within 60 days of AGM using MGT-7 for large companies and MGT-7A for OPCs and Small Companies.

name: Board Meeting Minutes
notes: Minutes must be recorded and signed within 30 days of the Board Meeting as per Secretarial Standard-1.

name: Auditor Appointment
penalty: ₹50,000 or higher depending on default as per Section 147
notes: File Form ADT-1 within 15 days of AGM for appointment/re-appointment of auditor.

name: Financial Statement Filing
penalty: ₹1,000 per day of delay as per Rule 12 of Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014
notes: Financial statements to be filed within 30 days of AGM along with necessary attachments.

name: Director KYC
section_ref: Rule 12A of Companies (Appointment & Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014
notes: Every director with DIN must complete KYC annually by 30th September.

name: Return of Allotment
notes: File within 30 days of share allotment for any increase in share capital or new issue.

name: Change in Registered Office
notes: File within 30 days of shifting registered office to update Registrar of Companies.

name: Change in Directors or KMP
notes: File within 30 days of appointment, cessation, or change in designation of directors or KMP.

name: Annual General Meeting (AGM)
notes: AGM to be held within 6 months from the end of the financial year (except first AGM within 9 months).

name: CSR Report Filing
notes: Applicable to companies meeting CSR thresholds; to be filed along with Form AOC-4 or separately if CSR applicable later.

name: Dividend Declaration
notes: Declared dividend must be transferred to a separate bank account within 5 days of declaration.

name: Auditor Resignation
notes: Auditor must file ADT-3 within 30 days of resignation to Registrar and the company.

name: Charge Creation or Modification
section_ref: Section 77 r/w Rule 3 of Companies (Registration of Charges) Rules, 2014
penalty: As per Section 86 – up to ₹5,00,000 for company and ₹50,000 for officers
notes: File Form CHG-1 within 30 days of creation or modification of charge on company assets.

name: Return of Deposits
section_ref: Rule 16 of Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014
penalty: As per Rule 21 – ₹5,000 per day during continuing default
notes: Annual filing of return of deposits, loans, and exempted borrowings before 30 June every year.

name: Appointment of Company Secretary
section_ref: Section 203 r/w Rule 8 of Companies (Appointment and Remuneration of Managerial Personnel) Rules, 2014
notes: Mandatory appointment for companies with paid-up capital ≥ ₹10 crore; file DIR-12 within 30 days.
